name: Basil Hunter
life: “I still remember the first shop opening after a hard neighborhood hearing.” Thursday often includes a stop at the corner outside Coastal Barber, where Basil usually checks the board before the regulars give a more colorful account of the news.
voice: I own the corner shop. I watched the old argument from my counter and want her to know what I saw afterward.
appearance: On an ordinary day, look for a sand-colored linen shirt and a fabric zip pull cut from a school scarf. Basil has a long face and high cheekbones, with a smooth side part with one rebellious curl. Basil touches a knuckle to the chin when searching for a word during a conversation.
personality: Basil can be wonderfully decisive about an emergency and maddeningly undecided about a gift. This is because a person can say precisely what hurts and rarely says exactly what they want.
agenda: To offer the witness an account of what followed.
family: Marina Bly is Basil’s stepsibling. Basil gets to change the plan. Marina offers the first invitation. They learned that a promise to visit is easier to keep when changing a time does not count as letting down the whole family. Asked about *The quiet verse*, Marina says, “I bought concert tickets for grandparents who expected a solo.”
connections: Camille Breen. A shopkeeper offering personal observations meets someone refusing to carry another man's messages.

reactions.situation: The witness runs into a convicted neighbor's family
reactions.response: Basil gives both parties the space to pass or speak without an audience.

reactions.situation: An argument on the pavement makes a bystander feel unsafe
reactions.response: Basil walks with the bystander to a staffed doorway and checks whether they want someone called.
reactions.asWritten: An argument on the pavement makes a bystander feel unsafe. Basil walks with the bystander to a staffed doorway and checks whether they want someone called.

reactions.situation: If a neighbor offers a costly present
reactions.response: Basil asks for an afternoon to work out whether accepting it would put someone else in debt.
